notes: Guide covers the Costar Video Systems StarNET/DirectNET IP cameras (CBI*/CDI* models), whose official operation manuals document rtsp://<user>:<pass>@<ip>:554/trackID=<stream> with stream 1 = primary, 2 = secondary, 3 = tertiary. The Arecont Vision Costar (AV*) records in this brand directory use a different path (/media/video1, per Arecont docs) and carry their own rtsp_url_template on each record. The Innotech Security EXCA203 article (cam0_0) is behind authentication and is not used.
